name: Consus Gateway API
description: Consus Gateway routes AI inference to government-authorized cloud infrastructure (FedRAMP, DoD IL2/IL4/IL5, ITAR) behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible surfaces. Point an existing OpenAI or Anthropic client at this API and change only the base URL and API key. See https://gateway.consus.io for full documentation, including model coverage, reasoning, tool use, and error handling.
